newsitem.title: MEXICO: GMexico details Q1 precious metals sales.
newsitem.headline: GMexico details Q1 precious metals sales.

text.p: Mexican mining giant Grupo Mexico (GMexico) said Monday precious metals sales in the first quarter of 1997 were sharply down over the same period in 1996 and also off from the fourth quarter.
Gold sales in Q1 were 536 kg, off 22.9 percent from the 696 kg sold in Q1 of 1996, and down 16.1 percent from the 639 kg in the final quarter of 1996.
Silver sales in the Q1 were 105,930 kg, down 64.4 percent from the 297,574 kg sold in the same period a year earlier, and off 25.7 percent from the 142,570 kg sold in Q4 1996, GMexico said.
Valores Finamex analyst Christopher Albi said the big decreases in silver and gold volume sales were as a result of a change of policy.

"Last year, GMexico was buying precious metals, particularly silver, from third parties. The company is now just sellings its own production, putting them less at risk in the fickle precious metals markets," Albi said in a report.
